# Product scope

- Start from `README.md` planned capabilities and Beta criteria.
- Choose one visual workflow one documented model and one reproducible input or prompt.
- Define output dimensions runtime hardware and evaluation criteria.
- State unsupported models editing modes and hardware profiles.
- Prefer one end-to-end pipeline over several disconnected experiments.
- Require reproducible examples tests and model limitations before completion.
